description: This PHP class, CalendarAccountEvent, models a calendar event within the SuiteCRM system. It encapsulates details such as event IDs, names, dates, locations, types, and synchronization metadata. The class provides methods for retrieving event properties, comparing events via content checksum, and managing linked external event identifiers.

classes.name: CalendarAccountEvent
classes.description: Represents a calendar event with fields for scheduling, metadata, and utilities for checksum calculation and property access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CalendarAccountEvent instance with provided event details, converting date strings to DateTime objects and computing content checksum.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the event.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name/title of the event.

methods.name: getDateStartString
methods.description: Returns the start date as an ISO 8601 formatted string.

methods.name: getDateStart
methods.description: Returns the start date as a DateTime object.

methods.name: getDateEndString
methods.description: Returns the end date as an ISO 8601 formatted string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getDateEnd
methods.description: Returns the end date as a DateTime object, or null if not set.

methods.name: getAssignedUserId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the assigned user.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the calendar event.

methods.name: getLinkedEventId
methods.description: Returns the linked external event ID, if any.

methods.name: setLinkedEventId
methods.description: Sets the linked external event ID.

methods.name: getLastSyncString
methods.description: Returns the last synchronization timestamp as an ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: getLastSync
methods.description: Returns the last sync time as a DateTime object.

methods.name: setLastSync
methods.description: Sets the last sync time.

methods.name: getDateModifiedString
methods.description: Returns the last modification date as an ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: getDateModified
methods.description: Returns the modification date as a DateTime object.

methods.name: isExternal
methods.description: Returns true if the event is external.

methods.name: getStartDateTime
methods.description: Returns the start date/time of the event.

methods.name: getEndDateTime
methods.description: Returns the end date/time of the event.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the event's title.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the event's description.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the event's location.

methods.name: getContentChecksum
methods.description: Returns the checksum string representing the event's content.

methods.name: getChecksumArray
methods.description: Returns an array of key property values used for checksum calculation.

methods.name: calculateChecksum
methods.description: Generates an MD5 checksum based on the event's key properties to facilitate quick equality comparison.
